exitCodes.meaning: The changes were discarded: tracked paths went back to their index version, untracked paths were deleted, hunks were reverse-applied. One journal entry, operation discard; `switchyard undo` brings every byte back.
Invalid arguments — no path and no --hunk, both paths and --hunk, --hunk without an id, or an unknown flag. A path that starts with - goes after --.
The request failed for a reason the other codes do not name.
Not a repository; a path that is conflicted, intent-to-add, a nested repository, a submodule, or has no unstaged change; or a hunk id that is unknown or stale. Nothing was discarded.

flags.help: Discard this unstaged hunk, by the id `switchyard hunks --unstaged` prints. Repeatable; not combinable with paths.

summary: Throw away unstaged changes to whole paths, or unstaged hunks by id. Staged changes are kept.
